name: Knot Fiction!
source:
[b]Game Outline[/b]

A flirty marriage with an older bride!

A story of flirting with a playful older bride.
Mainly female-dominant sex, and sometimes even sex where main character Yuuki goes wild!

[b]Genre[/b]

A wonderful adventure with your older bride.

[b]Concept[/b]

The second "married couple" project following HarmonEy is a work that focuses on flirting with an older bride!

[i]Point 1[/i]
Enjoy married life while your older bride teases you!
In this work, Yuuki fulfilled his childhood promise to marry the older girl next door, and gets childishly teased by his new wife as she supports him in his life!

[i]Point 2[/i]
It's the epitome of aggravating love!
Even though she and Yuuki are married now, their relationship is still like a boy and an older girl!
And he'll never be able to bridge that gap...!
She knows how hard he's trying, though, and she's sure to spoil him sometimes, too!
It's a sweet and adorable story.

[i]Point 3[/i]
Aggressive sex!
The heroine is very proactive and likes to top, but and sometimes Yuuki lets his inner beast out, too!
There are 10 whole sex scenes for you to enjoy!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677510/Knotfiction/]Steam[/url]]
